'''Megasecurity Ward 23''' was a secret vault that originally acted as a section of [[Belsavis prison]] and was later used by the [[Star Cabal]]. Its purpose was to store a number of weapons, technologies, and other treasures the organization had created and did not want released to the rest of the galaxy, including [[Microdroid/Legends|Microdroids]] and genetic maps. It was protected by the [[SCORPIO]] [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]].

The most respected members of the Star Cabal were kept in stasis in [[Kolto tank]]s in the Ward with one of their number being over 800 years old by [[3641 BBY]]. These individuals were kept alive because of their experience even though they themselves lamented on how the Star Cabal had become subverted from its original purpose.
